summary: Bounded Skill package validator/replay utility rooted at repository; computes SHA-256 file and package manifests; capability JSON resolves allowed root, validator entrypoint, package identity, and performs compatibility probe; validate-package returns schema jimuyun.skill-package-validation-receipt.v1, pass/exit 0, target manifest, resolved validator metadata, authorizes empty; replay-package wraps validation with capability hash, fixed entrypoint/command, detached-positive pass and detached-negative expected-failure probes; emits tc-d1 historical replay receipt, machine-bound portability, historical validator/evidence hashes and recorded pass; replay-matrix loads cases and emits pass results using case IDs/categories/surfaces/expected observations plus evidence and matrix hash; path containment and Python validator/file checks enforced; ambiguity none
